explanation: Deleting a List widget puts 4 errors in the debugger for about 50 ms and then they clear. AssertErrorCount read the counter once because its assertion was chained after a .then(), where Cypress does not retry. On a fast runner the read came after the flash; on a slow runner it landed inside the flash.
fix: Assert directly on the element query (GetElement(...).should('have.text', assertion)) so the check retries until the counter settles, within the default command timeout.
